title: CityGML Energy City-Build Input
description: Configuration for the city-scale builder (citygml_energy.city_builder). Generated by tools/generate_city_input_schema.py; do not edit by hand.

municipality.description: Dutch municipality name as used by PDOK bestuurlijkegebieden (case-insensitive).

bbox.description: Optional [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] in EPSG:28992 to narrow the fetch further than the municipality outline. Mutually exclusive with 'boundary'.

boundary.description: Optional free-form (possibly concave) polygon. When set, the fetch extent is derived from the polygon's own bounds, and buildings whose 2D LoD 0 footprint does not intersect the polygon are dropped. Mutually exclusive with 'bbox'. Two formats are accepted, dispatched on file extension: '.gpkg' (GeoPackage, requires 'layer' + 'fid') and '.geojson' / '.json' (single-feature or 'fid'-disambiguated).

path.description: Path to a GeoPackage (.gpkg) or GeoJSON (.geojson / .json) in EPSG:28992 (or srs_id 0/-1 for 'undefined'), absolute or relative to this JSON file.

layer.description: Required for .gpkg: name of the features table holding the boundary polygon(s). Ignored for GeoJSON (which has no layer concept).

fid.description: Required for .gpkg: feature id of the polygon to use. Optional for GeoJSON: when given, selects the feature whose 'id' or 'properties.id'/'fid' matches; when omitted, the first (Multi)Polygon feature is used.

lods.description: Subset of 3DBAG LoDs to attach per building.

include_addresses.description: Emit bldg:address per VBO using address fields embedded in the PDOK BAG WFS VBO response. Default: true.

include_energy_labels.description: Download EP-online and emit nrg3:EnergyPerformanceCertificate per matched VBO. Requires EP_ONLINE_API_KEY env var or ep_online_api_key_file. Default: true.

ep_online_api_key_file.description: Optional: path (absolute or relative to this JSON file) to a text file containing the EP-online API key. If not set, the loader falls back to EP_ONLINE_API_KEY environment variable (e.g., via .env file).

cache_dir.description: Directory used to cache BAG responses, 3DBAG tiles, and the EP-online CSV. Relative paths are resolved against this JSON.

output.description: Output .gml file path (created with parent dirs).

srs_name.description: CRS URN written onto gml:Envelope, gml:MultiSurface, gml:Solid. Defaults to urn:ogc:def:crs,crs:EPSG::28992,crs:EPSG::5109 (RD + NAP).

gml_id_prefix.description: Optional NCName prefix prepended to every generated gml:id. Useful when merging multiple city builds into one document.

pv_panels.description: Optional external PV panel polygon source. When set, the pipeline attaches one nrg3:PhotovoltaicCollector per panel to the Building with the largest 2D LoD 2 roof overlap. Geometry is stamped flat at the roof plane Z evaluated at the panel centroid plus z_offset_m.

path.description: Path to an OGC GeoPackage (.gpkg) in EPSG:28992, absolute or relative to this JSON file.

layer.description: Name of the features table inside the GeoPackage holding the panel polygons.

z_offset_m.description: Flat Z offset above the roof plane, in metres. Defaults to 0.1.

vegetation.description: Optional CFTree (https://github.com/NoahAlting/CFTree) reconstruction output directory. When set, the pipeline walks 'path/tiles/<tile_id>/<tree_filename>' and emits one veg:SolitaryVegetationObject per tree inside the bbox or boundary polygon, with LoD3 crown + trunk MultiSurface geometry and CFTree morphometrics (height, trunkDiameter, crownDiameter, plus porosity/r50/median_z as gen:doubleAttribute).

path.description: Path to a CFTree case output directory (typically CFTree's data/<case>), absolute or relative to this JSON file. The loader expects per-tile subdirectories below 'path/tiles/<tile_id>/'.

tree_filename.description: Filename to read inside every tile directory. Defaults to 'trees_lod3.city.json'; override only if a future CFTree release renames the file.
